REFERENCE 2 is ONLY a cropped appearance portrait with no legs: use the same face, brown eye, white blaze/muzzle/ruff, black back, white paws and white tail tip. Keep the eye and muzzle low with the neck following the trunk, not an upright alert head. Do not invent a camera zoom or change the body scale indicated by the first guide.
